description: This file defines the interface 'AccountingRuleWritePlatformService' which declares methods for creating, updating, and deleting accounting rules within the Fineract accounting module.

classes.name: AccountingRuleWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for managing accounting rules, including creation, update, and deletion.

methods.name: createAccountingRule
methods.description: Creates a new accounting rule based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: updateAccountingRule
methods.description: Updates an existing accounting rule identified by its ID using the provided JSON command.

methods.name: deleteAccountingRule
methods.description: Deletes the accounting rule specified by its ID.
